                    I have marked your mistakes
                    Notes:
                         1. Take care of the use of tenses. e.g.
                        a) He developed jaundice → 2 options: He has
                            developed jaundice / he has jaundice
                        b) Today, Mr Knowles’ condition has worsened →
                            means the worsening occurred only today. i.e.
                            Yesterday, he was good (which w don’t know). So,
                            the correct options are:
 Language     1/7                    (i) Today,      Mr     Knowles’      condition

                                     (ii) Recently/Lately/ Since the last visit/Over

                                          condition has worsened

                    Correct options: Today, / On today’s visit, / On today’s
